newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Seoul central bank absorbs 966 bln won from banks.
newsitem.headline: Seoul central bank absorbs 966 bln won from banks.

text.p: The central Bank of Korea on Monday absorbed 966 billion won from the banking system through five-day repurchase agreements (repos), an official at the bank said.
Earlier on Monday the bank invited tenders to sell the repos without setting in advance the amount it planned to absorb. The bank had usually set the sales amount ahead of tenders.
The repos were sold at 13.9 percent, the official said.
